Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
Vampire A is taking an action and is blocked by Vampire B. Vampire B has
a Monster card on him. A strikes hands, B strikes aggravated hands and
plays Roetschreck, A doesnt play psyche or similiar. A goes to torpor.
Can B use his Monster to untap or is the going to torpor part from
Roetschreck after combat?

--
Johannes Walch

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The latter. Monster only works when "combat involving this vampire ends and the
opposing minion is not ready". When Rötschreck ends combat, both vampires are
still ready.
